data_fields.name: kill_amount
data_fields.donor_constant: toughness minus damage marked minus damage assigned this step (lethal left)

data_fields.name: leftover_target
data_fields.donor_constant: trample: defending player; otherwise last target in order

data_fields.name: blocker_order_source
data_fields.donor_constant: attacking player's controller orders blockers when more than one (legacy rule)

best_idea: a lethal-first split of one damage pool across an ordered list of targets (pay each its kill amount while it fits, the rest goes to the last target or overflows), decided as a plan and applied once.
decision_why: a single cleave or multi-target hit needs one rule for who dies and how much of the hit is left, and the donor's order-then-stop rule gives one; adapt because the donor's order comes from the AI or a prompt, its trample overflow is an MTG rule, and its prevention prediction is out of scope for a fast game.
acceptance: server test: a 5-point cleave over enemies A (2 hp), B (3 hp), C (4 hp), in that order, kills A and B and leaves C at 4 hp; a 10-point cleave kills all three, with C taking the 5 left over; a shielded enemy in the list takes its lethal share and is not killed.
